Which models your agents can run on this machine, and the providers behind them.
Runs that need Anthropic are refused until this machine's runner has a key.
Run stigmer setup in a terminal on this machine, then restart Stigmer:
stigmer setup stigmer down && stigmer up
Runs that need OpenAI are refused until this machine's runner has a key.
Set OPENAI_API_KEY in the shell you start Stigmer from, then restart Stigmer:
export OPENAI_API_KEY=<your key> stigmer down && stigmer up
Runs that need Google are refused until this machine's runner has a key.
Set GEMINI_API_KEY in the shell you start Stigmer from, then restart Stigmer:
export GEMINI_API_KEY=<your key> stigmer down && stigmer up
